description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the core FilterParams class and includes properties for employee numbers and date range, as well as default sorting configuration.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filtering options when querying attendance records, including employee numbers and date range, with default sorting set to punch-in time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by punch-in time in descending order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used as a filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers to filter the attendance records.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the filter range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date for filtering attendance records.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of the filter range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date for filtering attendance records.
